scientific_integrity.assertion: A structural proof establishes the factorization for the stated graph class; finite enumeration supports but does not prove the general theorem.
limitations: Only bouquets of at least two cycles sharing precisely one cut vertex are treated.
The shape theorem concerns the connected forcing polynomial, not ordinary/total forcing polynomials.
Historical priority against unindexed literature is provisional; independent validation was not undertaken.

title: Connected-forcing polynomials of cycle bouquets: log-concavity and a sharp real-zero boundary
